regime_notes: No new ecosystem, candidate asset, or existing paper holding crossed a meaningful framework threshold after the 13:27 UTC SEC-tokenized-stock/AERO thesis update; no paper action is justified.

RAY remains a structurally cleaner Solana application-layer watch candidate, but fresh Santiment analysis shows daily active addresses down about 41% from the September 11 peak while price has held up much better. This weakens the usage-confirmation leg and reinforces the decision not to chase without selective-wallet confirmation.

PUMP has a reported seven-day smart-money balance increase concentrated in seven tracked wallets, but only a small increment occurred in the latest 24 hours and no independently verified fresh catalyst or funding-lineage confirmation clears the threshold. Custom-pair trader cashback also contaminates activity quality.
NEAR's current price/volume burst is rejected as a clean regime signal because the immediate catalyst includes an explicit milestone incentive / TVL snapshot and claim mechanics.

Arc remains a genuine high-velocity launchpad/memecoin regime but continues to be materially incentive-contaminated and no Arc-native leader has cleared the structural contract/holder/liquidity gates.

Tokenized-equity utilization remains substantive across Robinhood Chain, Solana and BNB Chain, and a newly listed FWDI tokenized equity on Solana has generated actual secondary turnover. This supports the broader RWA-utilization thesis but does not yet create clean incremental value capture sufficient for a new crypto paper position.

The SEC's five-year conditional tokenized-stock exemption remains a meaningful Base/Aerodrome addressable-market catalyst, but no verified post-exemption U.S. B20 launch, funded-wallet migration, Aerodrome stock-token volume acceleration, or fee increase has appeared yet; headline policy change is not counted as capital migration.

ZEC remains well above the blended paper basis and has substantial turnover, but the position is already at the 7.5% speculative cap and no fourth independently verified selective accumulator or renewed shielded-flow acceleration surfaced in this run.

Marked paper NAV is approximately $9,910.02 versus $9,798.86 for the frozen passive benchmark, ahead by $111.16 or about 113.4 bp. No current holding triggered a hard structural failure, thesis invalidation, trim, or exit condition.
